queryPlans.name: match_identity
queryPlans.statement: select id,lifecycle,home_score,away_score from private.provider_matches where league_id=$1 and source_event_id=$2

queryPlans.name: athlete_participation
queryPlans.statement: select m.id,m.kickoff_at,r.side,r.is_starter,r.did_play,r.minutes_played from private.provider_match_rosters r join private.provider_matches m on m.id=r.match_id where r.athlete_id=$1 and r.did_play is distinct from false order by m.kickoff_at desc limit 20

queryPlans.name: league_day
queryPlans.statement: select id,kickoff_at,home_name,away_name from private.provider_matches where league_id=$1 and kickoff_at>=$2::timestamptz and kickoff_at<$2::timestamptz+interval '1 day' order by kickoff_at,id limit 100

Plans.Recheck Cond: ((league_id = '13'::bigint) AND (kickoff_at >= '2026-10-16 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (kickoff_at < ('2026-10-16 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone + '1 day'::interval)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((league_id = '13'::bigint) AND (kickoff_at >= '2026-10-16 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (kickoff_at < ('2026-10-16 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone + '1 day'::interval)))

queryPlans.name: goal_timeline
queryPlans.statement: select g.id,g.side,g.clock,g.kind,g.is_retracted,a.display_name,p.role from private.provider_match_goals g left join private.provider_goal_participants p on p.goal_id=g.id left join private.provider_athletes a on a.id=p.athlete_id where g.match_id=$1 order by g.display_order,g.id limit 100

queryPlans.name: shared_room_fanout
queryPlans.statement: select m.id,m.session_id,m.last_applied_observation_version from public.matches m join public.game_sessions room on room.id=m.session_id where m.catalog_match_id=$1 and room.state='in_progress'

limits: Local inserted rows and indexes, not hosted capacity acceptance.
Physical allocation includes page/index slack and is baseline-dependent; pg_column_size is an actual row-datum measure, not allocation.
The forecast holds roster size, corrections and observations fixed; additional protected events/room participants increase growth.
One-participant rooms and first-score snapshot events do not represent every long-running game.
The finite1000-row Cron sample is scaled to40320 runs over seven days; real run text/status lengths can differ.
Rollback removes fixture rows; sequence advancement, WAL and allocated files are not transactional and are not claimed to shrink.
Disk/WAL limits are separate from pg_database_size and are not measured as hosted service usage.
